about: Gold set for my incident response knowledge base in my_kb/. 6 answerable + 2 unanswerable questions.

questions.question: Who has the authority to declare a security incident closed?
evidence: The Incident Commander is the only person who can declare an incident closed.

questions.question: How quickly do we have to acknowledge a critical SEV1 incident?
evidence: Acknowledge within 15 minutes, at any hour.

questions.question: A user typed their password into a phishing page. How far back should we review their sign-in logs?
evidence: Review sign-in logs for the last 14 days

questions.question: What should we do with the backup servers when ransomware is detected?
evidence: Take the backup servers offline from the production network

questions.question: How do we prove a forensic disk image is an exact copy of the original drive?
evidence: Calculate a SHA-256 hash of the original and of the image

questions.question: How long are security logs retained?
evidence: kept for one year online and an additional six years in archive
